items.title: Bristol-Myers Squibb Reports Mixed Phase 3 Trial Results for Sotyktu in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
items.summary: Bristol-Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) announced mixed topline results from two pivotal Phase 3 clinical trials evaluating Sotyktu (deucravacitinib) in adults with moderate-to-severe systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), with one study meeting its primary endpoint and the other falling short. The pharmaceutical company plans to conduct a comprehensive assessment of the available clinical data and engage with health authorities regarding the findings.

items.title: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) Names Kevin Dillon As CFO Successor For 2027
items.summary: Bristol-Myers Squibb (NYSE:BMY) has announced a planned Chief Financial Officer transition scheduled for March 2027. Kevin Dillon has been named as the successor to current CFO David Elkins, reflecting a planned leadership change in the finance role. The company highlighted Dillon's finance and strategic background as a key factor in his selection for the future CFO position. items.title: Coca-Cola Shakes up Leadership, Names Pharma Veteran as CFO
items.summary: Coca-Cola Company (NYSE:KO) announced Monday the appointment of David Elkins as its incoming executive vice president and chief financial officer, effective April 2, 2027. Elkins will succeed John Murphy, who plans to retire in 2027 after nearly four decades with the beverage giant. Murphy, who has been CFO since 2019, will continue serving as president, supporting the CFO transition and advancing key enterprise priorities during 2027.
